# brig service

Run services that sandboxes use, each with a token of its own

## Synopsis

```text
brig service COMMAND
```

## Description

A service is a workload that agents in sandboxes may use but never control,
such as a model proxy that holds the API key. Its type, built into brig,
decides what runs and where: most run in a VM of their own, which brig
creates from the base image like a gateway VM, with or without OpenShell.

[`brig service attach`](brig-service-attach.md) gives one sandbox a token for the service. brig keeps
only the token's hash, which the service checks callers against, and stores
the token as an OpenShell provider on the sandbox's gateway, attached to the
sandbox. The agent sees a placeholder; OpenShell adds the token to the
requests that the type's programs send to the service, at
http://host.openshell.internal:PORT, and to no others. A relay in the
gateway VM passes them on to the service's port on the host, and the
gateway's firewall lets them through.

Service VMs are VMs like others for [`brig start`](brig-start.md), stop, show, ssh, update
and sync, but [`brig list`](brig-list.md) leaves them out and brig delete refuses them: use
[`brig service list`](brig-service-list.md) and delete. The secrets of a service go from your keyring
into its VM's memory at every start: bind them in services/NAME.yaml of a
config directory of the service (see [`brig sync`](brig-sync.md) --help).

The [global options](brig.md#options) of brig apply too.

## Commands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`brig service attach`](brig-service-attach.md) | Give a sandbox a token for a service |
| [`brig service create`](brig-service-create.md) | Create and start a service |
| [`brig service delete`](brig-service-delete.md) | Delete a service, its VM and its tokens |
| [`brig service detach`](brig-service-detach.md) | Take a sandbox's token for a service away |
| [`brig service list`](brig-service-list.md) | List services |
| [`brig service show`](brig-service-show.md) | Show a service and the sandboxes attached to it |
| [`brig service start`](brig-service-start.md) | Start a service |
| [`brig service stop`](brig-service-stop.md) | Stop a service |
| [`brig service types`](brig-service-types.md) | List the service types that this brig has |
